{{Youmay|ghosts in folklore|[[Ghost (disambiguation)|other uses of the term]]}}
[[File:Halloween.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] dressed up as ghosts for Hallowe'en.]]
{{Quote|Arroo!&raquo;<br />&laquo;Whazzat?&raquo;<br />&laquo;It's only me. This party is great fun, isn't it?|translated=1|Teebo and Wicket W. Warrick in costume on Halloween|<ref name="CCK 13">{{StoryCite|story=Chief Chirpa Kidnapped!|book=Ewoks Annual}}</ref>}}
A '''ghost''' was a figure in the folklore of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]<ref name="CWA">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']].</ref> and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]<ref name="CCK 13" /> of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], located on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="EGC 184">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Dune ghost]]s were said to wander the [[wasteland]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> During the [[Standard year/Legends|yearly]] festival known as [[Halloween/Legends|Hallowe'en]], many Ewoks dressed up as ghosts as part of the festivities. A ghost costume consisted of a [[Color/Legends|white]] bolt of cloth pulled over the Ewok's head with round circles serving as [[Eye/Legends|eye]] holes.<ref name="CCK 13" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1905#14621041|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-04-20|time=11:42 AM}}</ref> for instance, the Ewoks [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] wore ghost costumes for the holiday. In this guise, Teebo scared Warrick as a prank.<ref name="CCK 13" />

==Behind the scenes==
In real life, ghosts appear in most belief systems. They are generally believed to be the lingering spirit of a deceased human.
